The diffuse orange-brown "bronzing" pattern with dark necrotic spots scattered throughout, and the way healthy green persists at the margins, is a hallmark pattern of Leaf Mold at an advanced stage where upper-surface chlorotic patches have merged and developed secondary necrosis — the darker spots represent areas of more advanced tissue death.
